import re

with open("дані/текст.txt", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    text = f.read()

sentences = re.split(r"[.!?]+", text)
word_re = re.compile(r"[^\W\d_]+", re.UNICODE)

items = []
k = 0
for s in sentences:
    words = word_re.findall(s)
    if not words:
        continue
    k += 1
    items.append((k, words))

items.sort(key=lambda x: (-len(x[1]), x[0]))

for k, words in items[:3]:
    print(f"№{k} ({len(words)} слів): {' '.join(words[:3])}")
